headline: The FDA approved Dupixent (dupilumab) for adults with bullous pemphigoid on June 18, 2025, its eighth approved use in the US. Sanofi and Regeneron announced it on June 20.
pdufa_note: The FDA's approval letter for supplement 70 to BLA 761055 is dated June 18, 2025 (FDA letter). Sanofi and Regeneron announced the approval on June 20, 2025 (Sanofi's release). This page replaces one dated June 2, 2025, a day nothing happened (see /corrections).
source_label: FDA approval letter, BLA 761055 S-070, June 18, 2025
h1: Dupixent (dupilumab) FDA approval for bullous pemphigoid: Jun 18, 2025

headline: The FDA issued a Complete Response Letter for tolebrutinib in non-relapsing secondary progressive multiple sclerosis on December 23, 2025, declining to approve it in its current form. Sanofi announced it on December 24.
pdufa_note: The FDA's Complete Response Letter for NDA 219624 is dated December 23, 2025 (FDA CRL file); in it the FDA writes that it was unable to identify a population for which the benefit could be clearly established. Sanofi announced the letter on December 24, 2025 (Sanofi's release). The review's target action date was December 28, 2025. This page replaces one dated December 28 (see /corrections).
source_label: FDA Complete Response Letter, NDA 219624, December 23, 2025
h1: Tolebrutinib (SNY) FDA Complete Response Letter in nrSPMS: Dec 23, 2025
